vulnerable_code:
@router.get("/api/v1/channels/{channel_id}/messages/cursor")
async def paginate_channel_messages(
    channel_id: str,
    after_id: Optional[int] = Query(None),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    async def message_batch_generator():
        stmt = select(ChannelMessage).where(ChannelMessage.channel_id == channel_id)
        if after_id:
            stmt = stmt.where(ChannelMessage.id > after_id)
        stmt = stmt.order_by(ChannelMessage.id.asc()).limit(50)
        res = await db.execute(stmt)
        rows = res.scalars().all()
        for row in rows:
            yield json.dumps({"id": row.id, "sender_id": row.sender_id, "content": row.content}) + "\n"

    return StreamingResponse(message_batch_generator(), media_type="application/x-ndjson")
diagnosis: The async generator queries and yields batches of channel messages using keyset cursor after_id without checking whether current_user is a participant or member of channel_id. Any authenticated user can stream confidential messages from private channels.
